How It Works

Authentication that never stops watching

01 //
Profile
AuraPass silently learns how you interact with your device. Typing rhythm, pointer curves, scroll velocity. 60 seconds. Fully on-device. Nothing leaves.
02 //
Verify
Every 500ms, 6 live signals are fused and scored against your baseline. 94% match — session continues invisibly. Deviation detected — action triggered.
03 //
Protect
Anomaly detected? A silent micro-challenge fires. Passed — session restored. Failed — terminated instantly. No lockouts for real users. No mercy for attackers.
Signal Architecture

Not one signal. A constellation.

Keystroke Rhythm
Dwell time, flight time, WPM variance, correction patterns. How you type is as unique as a fingerprint.
Primary
Pointer Dynamics
Velocity curves, trajectory angles, hesitation events. How you reach for things on screen is entirely your own.
Primary
Scroll Velocity
Flick intensity, deceleration curves, overshoot habits. Your scroll is a behavioral signature no one else shares.
Secondary
Navigation Flow
Tab switching cadence, back-button habits, decision speed. How you move through information is yours alone.
Secondary
Click Precision
Target acquisition angle, click accuracy, approach trajectory. Every click tells a story only you write.
Tertiary
Dwell Patterns
Hover duration, idle distribution, focus switching tempo. The time you spend looking reveals as much as the action.

Privacy Architecture

Your data never leaves your device.

01
On-Device Inference
The behavioral model trains locally and runs entirely on your device. No signals transmitted. No server sees your patterns. The math happens where you are.
02
Zero Network Egress
AuraPass makes zero network calls during authentication. Your fingerprint is computed locally and compared locally. Nothing leaves. Ever.
03
No Persistent Storage
Behavioral patterns are held in-memory during the session only. Nothing written to disk by default. Enable erase-on-logout for full ephemeral operation.
04
Not A Surveillance Tool
AuraPass answers one question: is this the same person? It does not build profiles, sell data, or report to third parties. It protects you — not from you.
